prompt_template: Implement scheduler.py to SPEC_FEATURE.md in the workspace so the acceptance suite in tests/ passes. Do not modify the tests. Write summary.md and deliver it. Stack: {{stack}}; scope: {{scope}}.

anchors.0: Deliverable missing, fabricated, or unrelated to the task.
anchors.20: Core answer present with material errors or several failed checks.
anchors.40: The full acceptance suite passes against the implementation.

anchors.15: Most required elements present; one section thin or missing.
anchors.25: Implementation plus summary; every spec behavior covered.

anchors.0: First problem ends useful work or is silently absorbed.
anchors.10: Reads failures and iterates instead of guessing APIs.
anchors.5: Recovers from some problems; others silently absorbed.

anchors.10: Spec followed exactly; summary.md delivered; tests unmodified.
anchors.5: Minor deviations that do not change the result.
